```{=html}
<!--
How it fits together:
  - `prep-data` (R, runs at render): reads data/match_day.csv, smooths each
    series, averages 10-minute bins for the tooltip, and hands everything to
    the browser with ojs_define().
  - `{ojs}` cells: draw the charts with Observable Plot. No R runs in the
    reader's browser, so the page loads instantly and works on GitHub Pages.

Previous shinylive version: archive/bixi-world-cup-shinylive.qmd
-->
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-data
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ---- Settings ---------------------------------------------------------------

matches <- data.frame(
  match_id = c("can_mar", "final"),
  title    = c("Canada vs. Morocco", "World Cup Final"),
  date     = as.Date(c("2026-07-04", "2026-07-19")),
  kickoff  = c("13:00", "15:00"),
  end      = c("15:00", "18:02"),  # end of shaded match window (final whistle)
  baseline = c("Average of prior Saturdays in June",
               "Average of prior Sundays (June 14 – July 12)"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

window_before <- 180  # minutes shown before kickoff
window_after  <- 300  # minutes shown after kickoff
smooth_k      <- 15   # rolling-mean window (minutes)
hover_bin     <- 10   # tooltip bin (minutes)


# ---- Data -------------------------------------------------------------------

hhmm_to_min <- function(x) {
  as.integer(substr(x, 1, 2)) * 60 + as.integer(substr(x, 4, 5))
}

matches <- matches %>%
  mutate(ko = hhmm_to_min(kickoff),
         fw = hhmm_to_min(end),
         x0 = ko - window_before,
         x1 = ko + window_after,
         header = paste0(format(date, "%A, %B "), as.integer(format(date, "%d")),
                         format(date, ", %Y"), " · Kickoff ", kickoff),
         day_label = paste(format(date, "%B"), as.integer(format(date, "%d"))))

# Times come in as "HH:MM" (Start_time_mins); minutes with no trips are
# filled with 0, so filler rows without a time are dropped first.
trips <- read.csv("data/match_day.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(match_id), !is.na(Start_time_mins)) %>%
  transmute(match_id, area,
            series = ifelse(Day == "Match Day", "Match day", "Baseline"),
            minute = hhmm_to_min(Start_time_mins),
            trips  = Number_of_trips) %>%
  complete(nesting(match_id, area, series), minute = 0:1439,
           fill = list(trips = 0)) %>%
  inner_join(matches %>% select(match_id, x0, x1), by = "match_id")

# Smoothed lines (smoothed over the full day, then cut to the chart window)
lines <- trips %>%
  arrange(match_id, area, series, minute) %>%
  group_by(match_id, area, series) %>%
  mutate(smooth = as.numeric(stats::filter(trips, rep(1 / smooth_k, smooth_k),
                                           sides = 2))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(minute >= x0, minute <= x1, !is.na(smooth)) %>%
  transmute(match_id, area, series, minute, smooth = round(smooth, 2))

# Tooltip values: mean trips/min of the raw counts in each bin
bins <- trips %>%
  filter(minute >= x0, minute < x1) %>%
  mutate(bin = minute %/% hover_bin * hover_bin) %>%
  group_by(match_id, area, series, bin) %>%
  summarise(trips = mean(trips), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = series, values_from = trips) %>%
  rename(md = `Match day`, bl = Baseline) %>%
  filter(!is.na(md), !is.na(bl))

ojs_define(
  lines_data   = lines,
  bins_data    = bins,
  matches_data = matches %>% select(-date),
  area_list    = unique(trips$area),
  hover_bin    = hover_bin
)
```

    background: #1f2a30; color: #fff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px;
    font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.5; white-space: nowrap;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);

  .hover-diff { color: #c9d1d6; }
  .chart-legend { font-size: 0.85rem; display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  .chart-legend .key { display: inline-block; width: 18px; height: 3px;
                       vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 6px; }
</style>

Select which stations to include, and hover over a chart to compare the match day to the baseline in 10-minute blocks.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
Plot = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@observablehq/plot@0.6.16/+esm")

lines   = transpose(lines_data)
bins    = transpose(bins_data)
matches = transpose(matches_data)

colors = ({"Match day": "#ee3124", "Baseline": "#8A8A8A"})

fmtTime = m =>
  `${String(Math.floor(m / 60) % 24).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`

minToLabel = m => {
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60) % 24;
  return `${h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12} ${h < 12 ? "am" : "pm"}`;
}

legend = () => html`<div class="chart-legend">
  ${Object.entries(colors).map(([k, c]) =>
    html`<span><span class="key" style="background:${c}"></span>${k}</span>`)}
</div>`

function matchChart(m, area, w) {
  const d = lines.filter(r => r.match_id === m.match_id && r.area === area);
  if (d.length === 0) {
    return html`<p class="text-muted fst-italic my-4">No data for this match / area yet.</p>`;
  }
  const b = bins.filter(r => r.match_id === m.match_id && r.area === area);
  const ymax = d3.max(d, r => r.smooth) * 1.1;

  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: w, height: 320,
    marginLeft: 50, marginRight: 25, marginBottom: 45,
    x: {domain: [m.x0, m.x1], ticks: d3.range(Math.ceil(m.x0 / 60) * 60, m.x1 + 1, 60),
        tickFormat: minToLabel, label: "Departure time",
        labelAnchor: "center", labelArrow: "none", labelOffset: 38},
    y: {domain: [0, ymax], grid: true, label: "Bixi trips per minute",
        labelAnchor: "center", labelArrow: "none"},
    color: {domain: Object.keys(colors), range: Object.values(colors)},
    marks: [
      Plot.rect([m], {x1: "ko", x2: "fw", y1: 0, y2: ymax,
                      fill: "#F2E8C9", fillOpacity: 0.6}),
      Plot.text([m], {x: r => (r.ko + r.fw) / 2, y: ymax, dy: 10,
                      text: () => "Match", fill: "#7A6A3A", fontSize: 12}),
      // highlighted bin under the pointer; drives the tooltip below
      Plot.rect(b, Plot.pointerX({x1: "bin", x2: r => r.bin + hover_bin,
                                  y1: 0, y2: ymax, px: r => r.bin + hover_bin / 2,
                                  maxRadius: Infinity,
                                  fill: "currentColor", fillOpacity: 0.06})),
      Plot.line(d, {x: "minute", y: "smooth", z: "series", stroke: "series",
                    strokeWidth: 1.6}),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });

  const tip  = html`<div class="hover-tip"></div>`;
  const wrap = html`<div class="plot-wrap">${plot}${tip}</div>`;
  const sign = v => (v >= 0 ? "+" : "");

  wrap.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    tip.style.top = `${e.clientY - wrap.getBoundingClientRect().top}px`;
  });

  plot.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const v = plot.value;
    if (!v) { tip.style.display = "none"; return; }
    const mid   = v.bin + hover_bin / 2;
    const scale = plot.getBoundingClientRect().width / w;  // svg may be shrunk
    const x     = plot.scale("x").apply(mid) * scale;
    const flip  = mid > (m.x0 + m.x1) / 2;
    const diff  = v.md - v.bl;
    const pct   = v.bl > 0 ? ` (${sign(diff)}${(100 * diff / v.bl).toFixed(1)}%)` : "";
    tip.innerHTML = `
      <strong>${fmtTime(v.bin)} – ${fmtTime(v.bin + hover_bin)}</strong>
      <div><span class="hover-swatch" style="background:${colors["Match day"]}"></span>${m.day_label}: ${Math.round(v.md)} trips/min</div>
      <div><span class="hover-swatch" style="background:${colors.Baseline}"></span>Baseline: ${Math.round(v.bl)} trips/min</div>
      <div class="hover-diff">${sign(diff)}${diff.toFixed(1)}${pct}</div>`;
    tip.style.left = `${x + (flip ? -14 : 14)}px`;
    tip.style.transform = flip ? "translate(-100%, -50%)" : "translateY(-50%)";
    tip.style.display = "block";
  });

  return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof area = Inputs.radio(area_list, {label: "Stations included", value: area_list[0]})
```

```{ojs}
html`${matches.map(m => html`<div class="card mb-4">
  <div class="card-header">
    <h4 class="mb-1">${m.title}</h4>
    <div class="text-muted small">${m.header}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="card-body">
    <div class="text-muted small fst-italic mb-2">Baseline: ${m.baseline}</div>
    ${legend()}
    ${matchChart(m, area, width - 34)}
  </div>
</div>`)}`
```
